summary: Sachem Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on June 4, 2026, announcing its board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.01 per common share and $0.484375 per preferred share, both payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 15, 2026. The filing is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation features such as a tender offer, acquisition, or strategic review. The registrant (issuer) simply announces ordinary cash distributions on its equity securities. As a standard current report on dividend activity, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situation classification. No deal terms, advisor roles, or premium data are present. This is purely a routine capital-return event without structural or strategic implications beyond the normal course.
